raw_text: BREAKING: Reports that Maldives has signed a military cooperation deal with China. Includes joint naval exercises, Chinese-funded coast guard facility on Marao atoll, and replacement of Indian military personnel with Chinese technical advisors. If confirmed, this is a seismic shift in Indian Ocean security dynamics. India Out campaign succeeded.
clean_text: Maldives reportedly signed China military deal. Joint exercises, coast guard facility on Marao, Chinese advisors replacing Indian military personnel.
